## Part A: Basic Operations

**A1**
```{r}
v <- seq(5,50, by = 5)
v

length(v)
sum(v)
mean(v)
```

**A2**
```{r}
w <- rep(c(1,2,3), times = 4)
z <- rep(c(1,2,3), each = 4)

w
z
```

**A3**
```{r}
rem <- 17%%5
int_div <- 17 %/% 5
pow <- 2 ^ 10
sq <- sqrt(144)
pi

rem
int_div
pow
sq
pi
```

**A4**
```{r}
a <- c(2,4,6,8)
b <- c(1,3,5,7)

plus <- a + b
prod <- a * b
logical_comparison <- a > b
dot_prod <- sum(a * b)

plus
prod
logical_comparison
dot_prod
```

**A5**
```{r}
## paste()

a <- 42
b <- 42L
c <- "42"
d <- 41i
e <- TRUE

typeof(a)
typeof(b)
typeof(c)
typeof(d)
typeof(e)
```

## Part B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements
**B1**
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M","M","F","F","M","F","M"),
  section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
students
```

**B2**
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
ncol(students)
summary(students)
```

**B3**
```{r}
students$average <- round((students$midterm + students$final) / 2, 1)
students$average
```

**B4** 
```{r}
students$passed <- (students$average >= 70) & (students$attendance >= 75)
students$passed
```

**B5**
```{r}
students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors",
ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))
students$standing
```

**B6**
```{r}
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85){
   return("Disfunction") 
  } else if (score >= 70){
     return("Merit")
  } else if (score >= 50){
    return ("Pass")
  } else {
      return("Fail")
    }
}
sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
```

## Part C: rbind() and cbind()

**C1**
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average <- round((new_students$midterm + new_students$final) / 2, 1)
new_students$passed <- (new_students$average >= 70) & (new_students$attendance >= 75)
new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors", ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

new_students
new_students$average
new_students$passed
new_students$standing
students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
students_all
```

**C2**
```{r}
quiz <- c(8,7,10,6,7,9,10,5,8,6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz)
class(students_all)
```
